initialization: published profile at first grid; successful constrained transfers thereafter
failure_policy: retain failed coarse stage and attempt 400 independently from the published profile; never transfer an unfinished state
property_table_note: The liquid enthalpy lower bound is 250 kJ/kg instead of the published 100 kJ/kg. This supported JAXProp configuration starts above the cold-water bulk-modulus maximum and avoids the false spinodal-ratio trigger. All published liquid states are above 534.6 kJ/kg. HEOS, metastable phase, pressure bounds, upper enthalpy bound, table resolution and gradient method are retained. Original YAML files remain unchanged; JAXProp source and admissibility checks are unchanged.
timing_note: One compilation-inclusive execution and one replay of the same initial hierarchy using retained bindings. Individual timing observations, not a repeated-sample speed benchmark. Property preparation and final audits excluded and reported separately.
old_timing: Not provided by the supplementary repository; no old runtime is inferred from CSV files.

agreement.note: Study-declared engineering screening criteria, not tolerances claimed by the publication. Numerical convergence and intended regime must pass independently.
